package.name: emori_skill_facade
package.description: The one component in the EMORI graph allowed to turn a decision into robot motion, and the plug point where that decision leaves ROS. It serves the bounded skill surface (/skill/replay_motion, /skill/look_at, /skill/set_expression) and hands each request to a transport - the hostapp's single-writer /api/skill intake, or another skill transport. Its own package precisely because that boundary should be replaceable without touching the behaviour node that decides.
package.author: Pokamind AB
